bodyLines: Emrah Çabkur, who founded Emrahair, is a hairdresser who specializes in hair color and cutting. Today he is the Türkiye Ambassador for Echosline, the Italian professional hair brand.
His specialty is Air Touch balayage and blonde tones lifted without damage. The words guests use most often in their reviews are clear advice, trust and care.
At his salon in Bahçeşehir, a team of five covers color, cuts, keratin treatments, bridal hair, nails and waxing under one roof.
